DangerousBytecode.title: Dangerous opcodes in implementation
DangerousBytecode.explanation: The proposed implementation's bytecode contains DELEGATECALL and SELFDESTRUCT, which could let it take over or destroy the proxy.

DelegatecallDetected.title: DELEGATECALL detected
DelegatecallDetected.explanation: The proposed implementation contains DELEGATECALL, allowing external code to run in the proxy's storage context.

SelfdestructDetected.title: SELFDESTRUCT detected
SelfdestructDetected.explanation: The proposed implementation contains SELFDESTRUCT, which could destroy the proxy and make its funds unrecoverable.

StateInvariantViolated.title: State invariant violated
StateInvariantViolated.explanation: Simulation changed monitored state outside the committed intent rules.

CommitmentMismatch.title: Commitment mismatch
CommitmentMismatch.explanation: The submitted actions and rules do not reproduce the queued execution commitment.

ExecutionReverted.title: Sandbox execution reverted
ExecutionReverted.explanation: The simulated execution reverted without a matching executor gate finding.

UnauthorizedUpgrade.title: Unauthorized upgrade path
UnauthorizedUpgrade.explanation: Simulation found an implementation change with no matching committed UPGRADE rule.

UnauthorizedOwnershipTransfer.title: Unauthorized ownership transfer
UnauthorizedOwnershipTransfer.explanation: Simulation found an ownership change with no matching committed ownership rule.

UnauthorizedAllowance.title: Unauthorized allowance
UnauthorizedAllowance.explanation: Simulation found an allowance change outside the committed approval ceiling.

UnauthorizedBalanceChange.title: Unauthorized balance change
UnauthorizedBalanceChange.explanation: Simulation reduced a monitored balance beyond the committed spend ceiling.

UnauthorizedRecipient.title: Unauthorized fund routing
UnauthorizedRecipient.explanation: Simulation routed funds to a recipient outside the committed transfer rules.

UnauthorizedDelegateCall.title: Unauthorized delegatecall
UnauthorizedDelegateCall.explanation: Simulation observed DELEGATECALL routing to an address outside the committed implementation set.

UnauthorizedStorageChange.title: Unauthorized storage change
UnauthorizedStorageChange.explanation: Simulation changed a monitored storage slot outside the committed intent.

RuleMismatch.title: Rule mismatch
RuleMismatch.explanation: The executed action does not match its committed rule.

CodeHashMismatch.title: Implementation code hash mismatch
CodeHashMismatch.explanation: The deployed implementation bytecode does not match the committed code hash.

SentinelViolation.title: Sentinel invariant violation
SentinelViolation.explanation: Simulation detected behavior outside the committed intent.
